capabilities.inputSchema: question, optional relatedFields

importantConstraints: Cannot modify, repeat, or loosen authoritative user constraints.

capabilities.name: INVESTIGATE_CANDIDATE_FACTS
capabilities.purpose: Read source-supported restaurant facts needed by the current request for known candidates.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; the router binds candidates and authoritative request conditions
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns candidate-associated source facts or an explicit unknown result; it never asserts availability.

capabilities.name: CHECK_AVAILABILITY

capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns fresh AvailabilityOffer records associated with candidate IDs.
importantConstraints: Only known candidates are valid; schedule values are never Agent-supplied; at most three unchecked candidates per read batch.

capabilities.name: END_READ
capabilities.purpose: End a bounded read-only investigation when its recorded scope has no grounded result to present.
capabilities.inputSchema: no business fields; optional short decision summary is trajectory-only
capabilities.resultMeaning: Writes a scoped NO_VERIFIED_RESULT outcome from authoritative investigation records, never a global negative claim.
importantConstraints: Only code may allow this after actual investigation; it cannot hide an internal failure, pending refresh, or grounded candidate.

capabilities.name: PRESENT_RESULTS
capabilities.purpose: Pause a read-only selection session with candidates whose required facts and availability are grounded.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; validator derives the required evidence from authoritative State
capabilities.resultMeaning: Writes an evidence-grounded result batch and waits for explicit user continuation; it does not select, authorize, or submit a booking.
importantConstraints: Every task-critical fact, including each HARD criterion and availability, must have current trusted evidence.

capabilities.name: SELECT_CANDIDATE
capabilities.purpose: Choose a discovered candidate and optionally its known offer for a possible booking proposal.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateId, optional offerId
capabilities.resultMeaning: Records the selection; it does not authorize or submit a booking.
importantConstraints: A selected offer must belong to the selected candidate.

capabilities.inputSchema: candidateId, offerId
capabilities.resultMeaning: Creates a deterministic ActionProposal and waits for valid user authorization.
importantConstraints: Cannot authorize, commit, or claim success.

From 11/1: Reserve 3 Days in Advance for Double Black Wagyu! Miraisaka Special Course with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Double Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Double Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Reserve by three days in advance during the period to enjoy double the amount of Wagyu in our Sukiyaki! This course features a luxurious Sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from Seiryu Wakadori, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish, making it perfect for special moments with your loved ones. You can also change the Sukiyaki to a Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Please indicate any changes in the remarks section. If no changes are noted, we will serve the "Wagyu Sukiyaki."

Indulge in a course featuring luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu beef, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from fresh river chicken, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish. This course is perfect for cherishing moments with your loved ones. You can also opt to change the sukiyaki to a seafood hot pot with Japanese pufferfish. Reserve by three days in advance during the promotional period to enjoy double the Omi beef in our sukiyaki! Indulge in a luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with specially selected Omi beef, or choose our Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Additionally, you can savor Omi beef eel rolls and domestic Japanese pufferfish kara-age, all while enjoying a 2.5-hour all-you-can-drink option. This course is perfect for creating cherished moments with your loved ones. If you have any specific requests for changes, please note them in the remarks section. From 11/1: Reserve 3 Days in Advance for Double Black Wagyu! Miraisaka Special Course with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Double Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Double Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Reserve by three days in advance during the period to enjoy double the amount of Wagyu in our Sukiyaki! This course features a luxurious Sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from Seiryu Wakadori, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish, making it perfect for special moments with your loved ones. You can also change the Sukiyaki to a Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Please indicate any changes in the remarks section. If no changes are noted, we will serve the "Wagyu Sukiyaki."

Indulge in a course featuring luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu beef, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from fresh river chicken, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish. This course is perfect for cherishing moments with your loved ones. You can also opt to change the sukiyaki to a seafood hot pot with Japanese pufferfish. If you wish to make this change, please indicate it in the remarks section. If no request is made, we will serve the "Wagyu Beef Sukiyaki."

Reserve by three days in advance during the promotional period to enjoy double the Omi beef in our sukiyaki! Indulge in a luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with specially selected Omi beef, or choose our Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. This course is perfect for creating cherished moments with your loved ones. If you have any specific requests for changes, please note them in the remarks section. From 11/1: Reserve 3 Days in Advance for Double Black Wagyu! Miraisaka Special Course with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Double Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Double Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Reserve by three days in advance during the period to enjoy double the amount of Wagyu in our Sukiyaki! This course features a luxurious Sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from Seiryu Wakadori, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish, making it perfect for special moments with your loved ones. You can also change the Sukiyaki to a Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Please indicate any changes in the remarks section. If no changes are noted, we will serve the "Wagyu Sukiyaki."

Miraisaka Special Course with Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Indulge in a course featuring luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu beef, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from fresh river chicken, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish. This course is perfect for cherishing moments with your loved ones. You can also opt to change the sukiyaki to a seafood hot pot with Japanese pufferfish. If you wish to make this change, please indicate it in the remarks section. If no request is made, we will serve the "Wagyu Beef Sukiyaki."

Reserve by three days in advance during the promotional period to enjoy double the Omi beef in our sukiyaki! Indulge in a luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with specially selected Omi beef, or choose our Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Additionally, you can savor Omi beef eel rolls and domestic Japanese pufferfish kara-age, all while enjoying a 2.5-hour all-you-can-drink option. This course is perfect for creating cherished moments with your loved ones. If you have any specific requests for changes, please note them in the remarks section. All you can drink

From 11/1: Reserve 3 Days in Advance for Double Black Wagyu! Miraisaka Special Course with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Double Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Double Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Reserve by three days in advance during the period to enjoy double the amount of Wagyu in our Sukiyaki! This course features a luxurious Sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from Seiryu Wakadori, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish, making it perfect for special moments with your loved ones. You can also change the Sukiyaki to a Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Please indicate any changes in the remarks section. If no changes are noted, we will serve the "Wagyu Sukiyaki."

Miraisaka Special Course with Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Indulge in a course featuring luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu beef, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from fresh river chicken, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish. This course is perfect for cherishing moments with your loved ones. You can also opt to change the sukiyaki to a seafood hot pot with Japanese pufferfish. If you wish to make this change, please indicate it in the remarks section. If no request is made, we will serve the "Wagyu Beef Sukiyaki."

From 11/1: Reserve 3 Days in Advance for Double Omi Beef! Gourmet Feast Course with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 6000 - A Satisfying Luxurious Banquet! Choose Between 'Sukiyaki of Omi Beef' or 'Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Reserve by three days in advance during the promotional period to enjoy double the Omi beef in our sukiyaki! Indulge in a luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with specially selected Omi beef, or choose our Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Additionally, you can savor Omi beef eel rolls and domestic Japanese pufferfish kara-age, all while enjoying a 2.5-hour all-you-can-drink option. This course is perfect for creating cherished moments with your loved ones. If you have any specific requests for changes, please note them in the remarks section. If no requests are made, we will serve the "Omi Beef Sukiyaki."

All you can drink

From 11/1: Reserve 3 Days in Advance for Double Black Wagyu! Miraisaka Special Course with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Double Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Double Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Reserve by three days in advance during the period to enjoy double the amount of Wagyu in our Sukiyaki! This course features a luxurious Sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from Seiryu Wakadori, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish, making it perfect for special moments with your loved ones. You can also change the Sukiyaki to a Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Please indicate any changes in the remarks section. If no changes are noted, we will serve the "Wagyu Sukiyaki."

Miraisaka Special Course with Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Indulge in a course featuring luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu beef, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from fresh river chicken, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish. This course is perfect for cherishing moments with your loved ones. You can also opt to change the sukiyaki to a seafood hot pot with Japanese pufferfish. If you wish to make this change, please indicate it in the remarks section. If no request is made, we will serve the "Wagyu Beef Sukiyaki."

From 11/1: Reserve 3 Days in Advance for Double Omi Beef! Gourmet Feast Course with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 6000 - A Satisfying Luxurious Banquet! Choose Between 'Sukiyaki of Omi Beef' or 'Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'!9 items

Reserve by three days in advance during the promotional period to enjoy double the Omi beef in our sukiyaki! Indulge in a luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with specially selected Omi beef, or choose our Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Additionally, you can savor Omi beef eel rolls and domestic Japanese pufferfish kara-age, all while enjoying a 2.5-hour all-you-can-drink option. This course is perfect for creating cherished moments with your loved ones. If you have any specific requests for changes, please note them in the remarks section. If no requests are made, we will serve the "Omi Beef Sukiyaki."

listedCourseDetails: From 11/1: Reserve 3 Days in Advance for Double Black Wagyu! Miraisaka Special Course with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Double Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Double Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'! — JPY 5,000 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 3 - 99. Reserve by three days in advance during the period to enjoy double the amount of Wagyu in our Sukiyaki! This course features a luxurious Sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from Seiryu Wakadori, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish, making it perfect for special moments with your loved ones. You can also change the Sukiyaki to a Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Please indicate any changes in the remarks section. If no changes are noted, we will serve the "Wagyu Sukiyaki."

Miraisaka Special Course with Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 5000 - Highly Recommended for Year-End Parties! Choose Between 'Sukiyaki of Black Wagyu' or 'Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'! — JPY 5,000 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 3 - 99. Indulge in a course featuring luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with carefully selected Wagyu beef, an assorted platter of sashimi, jumbo chicken thigh skewers from fresh river chicken, and nigiri of Japanese pufferfish. This course is perfect for cherishing moments with your loved ones. You can also opt to change the sukiyaki to a seafood hot pot with Japanese pufferfish. If you wish to make this change, please indicate it in the remarks section. If no request is made, we will serve the "Wagyu Beef Sukiyaki."

From 11/1: Reserve 3 Days in Advance for Double Omi Beef! Gourmet Feast Course with 2.5-Hour All-You-Can-Drink JPY 6000 - A Satisfying Luxurious Banquet! Choose Between 'Sukiyaki of Omi Beef' or 'Torafugu Seafood Hot Pot'! — JPY 6,000 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 3 - 99. Reserve by three days in advance during the promotional period to enjoy double the Omi beef in our sukiyaki! Indulge in a luxurious sukiyaki hot pot made with specially selected Omi beef, or choose our Japanese pufferfish seafood hot pot. Additionally, you can savor Omi beef eel rolls and domestic Japanese pufferfish kara-age, all while enjoying a 2.5-hour all-you-can-drink option. This course is perfect for creating cherished moments with your loved ones. If you have any specific requests for changes, please note them in the remarks section. If no requests are made, we will serve the "Omi Beef Sukiyaki."
